import numpy as np, os, re, json
from collections import Counter
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
def f(inp):
    arr=np.array(inp); c=Counter(int(v) for v in arr.flat)
    bg=int(c.most_common(1)[0][0])
    rs=[r for r in range(arr.shape[0]) if len(set(arr[r]))==1][0]
    cs=[c2 for c2 in range(arr.shape[1]) if len(set(arr[:,c2]))==1][0]
    sep=int(arr[rs,cs])
    blocks={'TL':arr[:rs,:cs],'TR':arr[:rs,cs+1:],
            'BL':arr[rs+1:,:cs],'BR':arr[rs+1:,cs+1:]}
    # pattern quadrant: contains a color distinct from bg and sep
    rem=set(map(int,arr.flat))-({bg,sep})
    # minority within quadrant = pattern color (use global rem if present)
    pat=None
    for k,v in blocks.items():
        kv=set(map(int,v.flat))-{bg}
        if kv & rem: pat=v
    if pat is None: pat=max(blocks.values(),key=lambda v:(np.array(v)!=sep).sum())
    T=np.flipud(pat); R=pat; B=np.fliplr(np.flipud(pat)); F=np.fliplr(pat)
    A=np.concatenate([np.concatenate([T,B],axis=1),np.concatenate([R,F],axis=1)],axis=0)
    # pattern color = minority value inside the pattern quadrant; everything else -> bg
    pc=Counter(map(int,pat.flat)).most_common()[-1][0]
    cm={int(v):bg if v!=pc else sep for v in set(map(int,pat.flat))}
    return [[cm[int(v)] for v in row] for row in A.tolist()]

import numpy as np, os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    pat=[c for c in cnt if c not in (bg,sep)][0]
    rs=[r for r in range(a.shape[0]) if len(set(map(int,a[r])))==1][0]
    cs=[c for c in range(a.shape[1]) if len(set(a[:,c]))==1][0]
    qmap={'TL':a[:rs,:cs],'TR':a[:rs,cs+1:], 'BL':a[rs+1:,:cs],'BR':a[rs+1:,cs+1:]}
    src=[q for q,v in qmap.items() if pat in set(map(int,v.flat))][0]
    O=[]
    for i in range(b.shape[0]):

        for j in range(b.shape[1]):

            # map back to input coords: if below sep use row+r, else row-r ... try col offset first

            ri = i+1 if i>=rs else i
            ci = j+1 if j>=cs else j
            if 0<=ri<a.shape[0] and 0<=ci<a.shape[1]:
                row.append(a[ri,ci])
            else:
                row.append(bg)
        O.append(row)
    # recolor: pattern cells -> sep; keep else
    res=[[sep if (v==pat) else (v) for v in r_] for r_ in O]
    O2=[]
    for i in range(b.shape[0]):
        row=[]
        for j in range(b.shape[1]):
            ri = i+1 if i>=rs else i
            ci = j+1 if j>=cs else j
            val=a[ri,ci]

import numpy as np, os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
a=np.array(G['Demo pair 4 input']); b=np.array(G['Demo pair 4 output'])
print(a); print(b)

import numpy as np, os,re,itertools
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

# Sampling family: for each axis choose (mode, offset): identity, or mirror with shift s
def sample_fam(H,W,Hd,Wd,sep_r,sep_c):
    # returns dict of (fr,fc) -> lambda idx->coord
    outs={}
    for mode in ['id','flip']:
        for s in range(-H, H+1):
            fn=lambda rr,s=s: rr if mode=='id' else (-rr+s)
            for smode in ['id','flip']:
                fc=lambda cc,s=s: cc if smode=='id' else (-cc+s)
                key=(mode,smode,s)
                def make(fr,fc):
                    def fn_(i,j):
                        r = fr(i); c = fc(j)
                        if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W: return a[r,c]

import os,re,numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    H,W=a.shape; H2,W2=b.shape
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(a[i].tolist()))==1][0]; sc=[j for j in range(W) if len(set(a[:,j].tolist()))==1][0]

    sep=int(a[sr,sc]); pat=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg and v!=sep][0]
    O=np.full_like(b,bg,dtype=int)
    # 180 rot of everything except sep lines; map remaining into H-1 x W-1 by dropping them

    ii=[i for i in range(H) if i!=sr]; jj=[j for j in range(W) if j!=sc]

    O=(U!=bg).astype(int)*sep
    mis=(O!=b).sum(); print(n,'180rot-drops-sep',mis)

import os,glob,re,numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def parts(n):
    a=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); b=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    H,W=a.shape; H2,W2=b.shape
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if len({v for v in a[i]})==1][0]
    sc=[j for j in range(W) if len({a[r,j] for r in range(H)})==1][0]
    cnt=Counter(int(v) for v in a.flatten()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep=int(a[sr,sc]); pat={v for v in cnt if v!=bg and v!=sep}
    return a,b,H,W,H2,W2,sr,sc,bg,sep,pat
for n in [1,4]:
    a,b,H,W,H2,W2,sr,sc,bg,sep,pat=parts(n)
    print(f'--- demo {n}')
    for i in range(max(H,H2)):
        row_in = ''.join('#' if int(a[i,j]) in pat else ('S' if (i,j)==(sr,sc) else '.') for j in range(W))
        row_out = ''.join('#' if int(b[i,j])==sep else '.' for j in range(W2)) if i<H2 else ''
        print(f'{i:3d}',row_in,' ',row_out)
